desktop_command_requests_claimed_at_chec.name: desktop_command_requests_claimed_at_check
desktop_command_requests_claimed_at_chec.value: ("desktop_command_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "desktop_command_requests"."claimed_at" is null and "desktop_command_requests"."claimed_by" is null) or ("desktop_command_requests"."status" in ('claimed', 'completed') and "desktop_command_requests"."claimed_at" is not null and "desktop_command_requests"."claimed_by" is not null) or ("desktop_command_requests"."status" = 'expired')

feishu_intake_candidates_confirmed_targe.name: feishu_intake_candidates_confirmed_target_check
feishu_intake_candidates_confirmed_targe.value: "feishu_intake_candidates"."state" <> 'confirmed' or ("feishu_intake_candidates"."target_task_id" is not null or "feishu_intake_candidates"."target_inbox_entry_id" is not null)

focus_sessions_planned_interval_check.name: focus_sessions_planned_interval_check
focus_sessions_planned_interval_check.value: "focus_sessions"."planned_start_at" is null or "focus_sessions"."planned_end_at" is null or "focus_sessions"."planned_end_at" > "focus_sessions"."planned_start_at"

health_week_plans_revision_base_check.name: health_week_plans_revision_base_check
health_week_plans_revision_base_check.value: ("health_week_plans"."based_on_plan_id" is null and "health_week_plans"."based_on_plan_version" is null) or ("health_week_plans"."based_on_plan_id" is not null and "health_week_plans"."based_on_plan_version" > 0)

task_outcomes_value_check.name: task_outcomes_value_check
task_outcomes_value_check.value:
("task_outcomes"."outcome" = 'not_completed' and "task_outcomes"."progress_percent" = 0)
        or ("task_outcomes"."outcome" = 'partial' and "task_outcomes"."progress_percent" between 1 and 99)
        or ("task_outcomes"."outcome" = 'complete' and "task_outcomes"."progress_percent" = 100)

tasks_time_pair_check.name: tasks_time_pair_check
tasks_time_pair_check.value: ("tasks"."start_at" is null and "tasks"."end_at" is null) or ("tasks"."start_at" is not null and "tasks"."end_at" is not null)

tasks_exact_minimum_duration_check.name: tasks_exact_minimum_duration_check
tasks_exact_minimum_duration_check.value: "tasks"."deleted_at" is not null or "tasks"."end_at" is null or "tasks"."end_at" >= "tasks"."start_at" + interval '30 minutes'

tasks_exact_half_hour_boundary_check.name: tasks_exact_half_hour_boundary_check
tasks_exact_half_hour_boundary_check.value:
"tasks"."deleted_at" is not null or "tasks"."start_at" is null or (
        extract(minute from "tasks"."start_at" at time zone "tasks"."time_zone") in (0, 30)
        and extract(second from "tasks"."start_at" at time zone "tasks"."time_zone") = 0
        and extract(minute from "tasks"."end_at" at time zone "tasks"."time_zone") in (0, 30)
        and extract(second from "tasks"."end_at" at time zone "tasks"."time_zone") = 0
      )

tasks_schedule_shape_check.name: tasks_schedule_shape_check
tasks_schedule_shape_check.value:
(
        ("tasks"."schedule_kind" = 'none' and "tasks"."start_at" is null and "tasks"."end_at" is null and "tasks"."daypart" is null)
        or ("tasks"."schedule_kind" = 'daypart' and "tasks"."local_date" is not null and "tasks"."daypart" in ('morning', 'afternoon', 'evening') and "tasks"."start_at" is null and "tasks"."end_at" is null)
        or ("tasks"."schedule_kind" = 'exact' and "tasks"."local_date" is not null and "tasks"."start_at" is not null and "tasks"."end_at" is not null and "tasks"."daypart" is null)
      )
